scope: Independent benchmark contract, failure scoring and frozen-tool integrity audit; no performance run.
accepted_contract_parts: Actual Rust and ZIL compile-to-executable commands; no Cargo no-op substitution; phase timing disabled.
O0/O2 and cold/incremental plans separated; native Rust codegen-unit default retained, matched profile explicitly diagnostic.
Checked arithmetic and valid-input corpus bounds aligned; std/libc differences and allocation/panic failure limits disclosed.
Every compiler process and reaped descendant CPU cost measured through wait4; construction/link included; source generator and independent oracle are benchmark setup.
ABBA/BAAB balanced blocks, paired mean then block median then weighted absolute times; heterogeneous 48-row Decimal control matches within 4e-14 absolute.
Runtime executes frozen base artifacts in separate window, with compilation/startup diagnosis/warmup unscored.
Missing/failed/timed-out rows, changed source/log/oracle and mutated output controls reject scoring in tested paths.

blocking_findings.problem: An explicit ZIL_LINUX_LINKER executable is not automatically inventoried. Keeping its environment string unchanged while changing file bytes passes load().
blocking_findings.reproduction: Synthetic temporary SDK files, mocked sysroot probe/PATH enumeration, actual tool_inventory and load implementations.
blocking_findings.required_change: Freeze and revalidate actual explicit linker path/name resolution and executable identity, not only the environment variable text.

blocking_findings.problem: Resolving ld.lld to its target when freezing loses the callable alias path. Retargeting the clang-sibling ld.lld symlink while leaving old target intact passes load().
blocking_findings.reproduction: Real symlink changed from lld-one to lld-two; actual load check accepts.
blocking_findings.required_change: Retain selection/alias path and re-resolve it during validation; reject changed selection even when the previously resolved binary is unchanged.

independent_tests.kind: two independently constructed actual inventory/load counterexamples
independent_tests.result: Both forbidden drifts accepted by original candidate

failure_scope: This is a frozen-tool completeness failure, not evidence that any existing measurement was contaminated and not a rejection of the overall Rust comparison design.
